execution_note: Five local seeds using the committed Gate-10C protocol.
decoder_access: unsatisfied-clause context plus observed acted-on clause index, selected variable, and target phase; hidden adapter source is not used by decoder

ground_truth_for_posthoc_scoring_only.clause_selection: uniform subset without replacement, up to 10
ground_truth_for_posthoc_scoring_only.historical_mismatch: selected variable can come from a different literal than the literal whose sign sets the target

decoded_policy.clause_choice: choose 10 distinct unsatisfied clauses with approximately uniform inclusion probability when at least 10 are available
decoded_policy.variable_choice: choose one of the three literals in the selected clause approximately uniformly, then intervene on that literal's variable
decoded_policy.target_rule: target positive iff the FIRST literal of the selected clause is positive
decoded_policy.bug_receipt: target sign is not tied to the selected literal. On controlled counterfactuals, flipping a selected non-first literal leaves the target unchanged 100% of the time, while flipping clause[0] changes the target 100% of the time.

interpretation.positive: The black-box policy decoder recovered the historical sign-selection mismatch without using the SAT adapter source. This crosses from low-level equation fitting into compact policy/program recovery with a causal bug test.
interpretation.scope_limit: The acted-on clause index is observed. The decoder is not yet inferring latent clause identity solely from downstream phase/weight traces, and it is not reconstructing the whole SAT solve loop from raw trajectories.
interpretation.next: Gate 10D should remove the observed clause index and infer which constraint was acted on from the downstream structural trace, then assemble a compact end-to-end policy description.
